To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the mPIMA HIV 1/ 2 VL assay has a good performance in point-of-care settings in Kenya and can be used to monitor viral load in patients on antiretroviral therapy.

1) The mPIMA™ is a rapid, simple, and accurate test for quantifying HIV viral load; 2) The mPIMAs performance in Kenya was similar to its performance in the US; 3) mPIMA was highly accurate in the field and was comparable in performance to the gold-standard HIV viral load test, 4) mPIMAs accuracy and performance in Kenya was not influenced by the presence of co-infections with other viruses; 5)

1) The mPIMA HIV-1 VL test is a rapid, simple-to-use, and highly accurate test that can be performed at the point of care; and, 2) The mPIMATM HIV-1 VL assay is an accurate and sensitive test for monitoring ART effectiveness and for early diagnosis of virological failure.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new HIV-1 rapid diagnostic test, mPIMA, for point-of-care testing (PoCT), and its evaluation for use in resource-limited settings.
the use of the mPIMA™ test for HIV viral load testing.
the development of a new HIV-1 viral load assay, the mPIMA™, which is based on a novel, patented technology, the mPima™ technology platform.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the HIV-1 RNA viral load test is the most accurate test for determining the amount of HIV in the blood.
the mPIMA™ assay is a useful point-of-care test for HIV-1/2 viral loads in the resource-constrained setting.
the mPIMA™ test is a reliable, sensitive, and specific test for the detection of HIV 1/ 2 antibodies in point of care and laboratory settings.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the performance and usability of the mPIMA HIV-1/2 VL test in POC settings in Kenya was good and acceptable.
the mPIMA HIV 1/ 2 Viral Load test is a reliable and accurate tool for HIV viral load testing in resource limited settings, including point of care settings.
we have developed and tested a point of care HIV-1 viral load test that is simple, fast, accurate and robust.

we have developed a new method to measure the HIV viral load in the field, using a single drop of blood from an HIV-positive person.
